sections.brief: The UN since October 2023: Security Council votes and the six US Gaza vetoes plus the membership veto (count methods), resolutions passed, Resolution 2803; General Assembly votes 2024-25 and the New York Declaration; the UNRWA laws and the OIOS findings; the Commission of Inquiry; UNIFIL's final mandate; Israel's and the US's stated positions beside each. Figures: time; stats

ICJ South Africa v. Israel (Jan, Mar, May 2024 orders; pleadings to 2029); advisory opinions of 19 July 2024 and 22 Oct 2025 and the GA's 12-month deadline; ICC warrants of Nov 2024, Deif, Israel's challenge, US sanctions on the court (links ow11_icc); national courts (UK High Court June 2025, Dutch courts 2024-25); what binds and what does not. Figure: compare

What states did: recognitions of Palestine 2024-25 (157 of 193); arms restrictions and their limits (UK, Germany, Netherlands); sanctions on Ben-Gvir and Smotrich, US settler sanctions revoked, EU settler sanctions 2026, the stalled EU trade suspension; Turkey's trade cut-off; Arab positions (Saudi condition, UAE red line, the 31-state statement), the Abraham Accords holding and Kazakhstan; Colombia's Golan recognition the other way. Figures: time; compare

Why support persists, documented drivers only: US law and the 2016 MOU, QME, the 2024 supplemental and 2025 acceleration; arms-industry ties (Israeli exports, German supply, F-35 programme arguments in court); intelligence sharing; lobbying money (disclosure not causation); alignment against Iran; then erosion (Gallup 2026, Senate votes 2024-25, recognitions); three readings labelled as argument. Figures: compare; stats
